purpose: Pre-registered return-first verification of the selected risk-aware ownership mechanism; not the dynamic four-reference acceptance gate.

risk_mechanism.protection_trigger: at least two independent market-damage channels plus shock or account-loss acceleration
risk_mechanism.allocation: retain holdings by descending causal trend strength and reduce the weakest holdings first
risk_mechanism.open_revalidation: defer an individual protective sell when its next-session opening gap is positive; reassess at the next close
risk_mechanism.partial_trim_materiality: ownership-mode partial reductions use the shared one-percent-of-NAV order floor; full exits remain urgent
risk_mechanism.recovery: restore remembered ownership immediately after confirmed risk clears and executable protection is complete

selection_objective: until the four-reference return gate can be computed, maximize the minimum candidate wealth divided by same-engine passive wealth
require drawdown improvement in all seven internal screen cases
after formal return qualification, optimize dynamic four-reference drawdown margin
then compare turnover, costs and stability
do not use the final-evaluation window for mechanism selection

acceptance_relationship.formal_return_hard_gate: quant terminal wealth must reach the highest of the four references in every mandatory exact case
acceptance_relationship.formal_drawdown_role: secondary optimization objective after the return hard gate
acceptance_relationship.ideal_drawdown_target: strictly below the worst maximum drawdown among the four references in the same exact case

limitations: This internal screen cannot pass the dynamic relative contract because exact four-reference results remain incomplete.
The passive baseline is a same-engine diagnostic, not a substitute for the four read-only reference strategies.
The 2026 final-evaluation window is not read or used to choose this mechanism.
The selected mechanism remains research-only until every mandatory exact case has complete references and meets the return hard gate.
Drawdown remains mandatory to measure and optimize even though its ideal target is not the economic hard gate.
Backtest results do not guarantee future returns.
